prompt: Target: 1-pentanol starting from 1-butanol. Chain extension by one carbon is best done via:

options.label: 1-butanol → 1-bromobutane (HBr) → butanenitrile (NaCN) → pentanoic acid (H₃O⁺) → 1-pentanol (LiAlH₄). Adds the CN carbon.
1-butanol → 1-bromobutane → BuMgBr → formaldehyde (HCHO), workup — adds one C via Grignard + HCHO
Both (A) and (B) are valid chain-extension routes
Chain extension by one carbon isn't possible

explanation: Both are classic one-carbon chain extensions: nitrile hydrolysis adds the CN carbon (ultimately as -CH₂OH after full reduction); Grignard + formaldehyde adds HCHO's carbon. Grignard is usually shorter (2 steps vs 4).
